Upstream: https://github.com/kstenerud/Musashi commit 313ebf1bd9f4d0d93341eb5ce21fd8a119e9dbdd (2026-03-08). MIT licence: see readme.txt. Only m68kconf.h is changed for this project: 68000 only (010-040 and PMMU off), and the interrupt acknowledge callback is md_int_ack (harness/main.c).

softfloat/ (John R. Hauser, SoftFloat release 2) is bundled by Musashi for its FPU emulation, which a
68000 never uses; it is compiled only because m68kcpu.c includes m68kfpu.c. Its own licence is in
softfloat/README.txt: redistribution and derivative works are allowed with the notices kept, under
an "as is" disclaimer that also asks users to indemnify the author.
